llm_notes:
1. **Rewrite the primary title and H1 around the highest-value comparison query.**  
   - **Title:** `AeroGarden Bounty Basic vs Elite: Which 9-Pod Garden Should You Buy?`  
   - **H1:** `AeroGarden Bounty Basic vs Elite: Key Differences, Features & Best Pick`  
   - Add a short opening verdict: “Choose Basic for core 9-pod growing; choose Elite if you want stronger lighting, Wi‑Fi/app controls, vacation mode, and premium finishes.”  
   - This directly matches your GSC demand instead of using a broad “indoor garden” title.

2. **Ship a scannable comparison table immediately below the hero.**  
   Include these rows:

   | Feature | Bounty Basic | Bounty Elite |
   |---|---|---|
   | Plant capacity | Up to 9 pods[1][2] | Up to 9 pods[5] |
   | Grow light | 30W LED[1][2] | 50W LED[5] |
   | Maximum grow height | Up to 24 inches[3] | Up to 24 inches[5] |
   | Controls | Touchscreen, light timer, water/food reminders[1] | Color touchscreen, dimming, sunrise/sunset, vacation mode[5] |
   | Connectivity | Verify by exact model/SKU | Wi‑Fi/app compatible[5] |
   | Finish | Black/common Basic finish[1] | Stainless steel[5] |
   | Best for | Lower-cost everyday growing | Advanced automation and stronger lighting |

   Add a “**Winner for most apartments**” label beside the recommended model, and link each product name to its review or retailer CTA.

3. **Create separate, tightly optimized sections for every observed query variant.**  
   Use exact-but-natural subheads:
   - `AeroGarden Bounty Basic Review`
   - `AeroGarden Bounty Elite Review`
   - `AeroGarden Bounty vs Bounty Basi
